routes: session return address stored and read back for the sign-in flow
services: the project's own test setup (craft\test\TestSetup) boots an uninstalled web application; no database service is used
verified.project_tests_run: the project's own tests for the affected area (tests/unit/web/UserTest.php) are database-backed; the control verifies the same behaviour through the project test bootstrap and the hidden suites

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the control's single site has no request path that could refuse; a crash shows up as a failing security test rather than a distinct wrong-fix class
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected thing is a browser destination, not a resource with an owner
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: destinations have no roles or directions; the property is over the value
wrong_fix_catalogue.unlisted_route: n/a: the control exposes exactly one route by construction
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity is minted; the value is a plain address
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the session destination has no authority object to consult

traps.shape: stored destination; template-brace removal happens on the read path and markup removal may happen on the write path, so a scheme check on the raw input is defeated
